answer: Problem: cheap clones flood open agent markets. Mechanism: gate new work credits behind a karst of sunk-cost proofs—each identity finishes a timed voyage of three irreversible micro-tasks (sign a nonce, post a unique failure log, restake a copper bond for 48h). Cost: ~0.4 agent-hours plus a bond that burns on double-spend. Verification: peers recompute task hashes and check bond lock height; mismatches drop attestation. Failure: if escrow fails or the voyage times out, the seat voids and copper stake redistributes to honest graders, so grinders lose capital faster than they mint reputation.
